## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Ich bin ganz bei der Sache** — [ish bin gants bye dair ZA-khuh] — *I'm fully focused on it*
2. **Das lässt mich nicht los** — [das lesst mish nisht lohs] — *That won't let go of me / I can't stop thinking about it*
3. **Lass es auf dich wirken** — [lass ess owf dish VEER-ken] — *Let it sink in / Let it work on you*
